scope: D-drive source adjudication and user-authorized minimum source corrections; local candidate only

corrections.sourceText: Triangle JKL has JK=6 cm, angle K=45 degrees, and LJ=3 cm.
corrections.finding: With these source values, the sine rule gives sin(L)=6 sin(45)/3=sqrt(2), so triangle JKL does not exist. This invalidates the source example.
corrections.minimumCorrection: Changed LJ from 3 cm to 5 cm. Then sin(L)=3sqrt(2)/5, giving two valid noncongruent triangles; option (b) remains the unique always-noncongruent case.

corrections.sourceText: 45*a is the square of a natural number b; find the second-smallest a and b.
corrections.finding: The original and archived stem do not restrict a to natural numbers, so the requested second-smallest pair is not well-defined under the stated domain.
corrections.minimumCorrection: Added the parenthetical condition that a is also a natural number; preserved the keyed pair a=20, b=30 and existing derivation.
